name: Marketing Bot (CMO)
tagline: A CMO bot that turns your product into the marketing around it
description: Give it the product context once and it produces the copy, the emails, the offers and the conversion ideas, rather than answering one marketing question at a time.

source.excerpt: Shared as a marketing chief that starts from your product and writes the whole surface.

body:
## What it does

Give it the product context once and it produces the copy, the emails, the offers and the conversion ideas, rather than answering one marketing question at a time. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @tymarsha shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
